headline: KC Council Oct. 22: sewer bonds, City Hall upgrades, fund changes

sentences.text: Ordinance 260895 authorizes issuing up to $100,000,000 in Sanitary Sewer System Revenue Bonds Series 2026A.
Ordinance 260920 authorizes spending up to $1,100,000 on audio and video system upgrades at City Hall.
Ordinance 260918 reduces Marijuana Sales Tax Fund appropriations (money set aside for a purpose) by $485,424 and reappropriates the money for the Extreme Weather Program.
Ordinance 260913 authorizes accepting a $486,054.54 Assistance to Firefighters Grant from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.
Ordinance 260919, which sets up Fund No. 2220, the ProspectUs Fund, was passed.
Ordinance 260948 authorizes a five-year agreement with Visit KC starting on May 1, 2027.
Ordinance 260445, which vacates (gives up the city's claim to) sidewalk right-of-way in the Country Club Plaza area, was held on the docket (the meeting agenda) for two weeks, until November 5.
